description: This file defines a 'Constant' class used to represent mathematical constants within an expression evaluation library. It encapsulates the mnemonic name of the constant and provides a constructor and accessor method.

classes.name: Constant
classes.description: Represents a mnemonic constant in an expression, such as pi or e, for use within an expression evaluator.

methods.name: Constant
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the constant with a mnemonic name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the mnemonic name of the constant.
